# Canvas demo media

These compact fixtures are derived from the user's `shanghai_rain_night`
project solely for local H3Storyboard canvas testing.

- `su-wanning.jpg` and `gu-chengyuan.jpg` are resized character references.
- `rain-night-take-01.mp4` and `rain-night-take-02.mp4` are short H3 scene
  outputs with every audio stream removed. They are intentionally silent so
  the demo cannot introduce TTS, dubbing, ambience, music, or synthetic audio.
- `rain-night-take-01-tail.png` is a real extracted tail frame from Take 01 for
  testing approved-Take continuity dragging in P1.5B.

The demo seeder copies these files into an isolated data directory. It never
connects to ComfyUI or the 4090 worker.
